poses.name: 08 squat
poses.positive: deep squat, knees spread wide, feet flat, hands on knees, crotch visible, whole body inside the frame, empty margin above the head
poses.negative: hand covering crotch, standing, cropped head, cropped feet, stretched legs

poses.name: 09 rear
poses.positive: bent forward at the waist, true rear view, back to the camera, knees slightly bent, not kneeling upright, not three-quarter
poses.negative: looking over shoulder, front view, belly, navel, kneeling upright, standing straight
